title: Retail Installment Contracts Fee Schedule: The Returned-Payment Fee and State Returned-Check Limits
content:
**Clause.** The returned-payment fee on a contract under Retail Installment Contracts is the tier's returned-payment fee, rounded half-up to the cent.

**Assembly.** The fee amount can be replaced, and amounts can be added to it or taken from it; the returned-payment fee is then that amount plus every amount added, less every amount taken, never below zero and never above the state cap, rounded half-up to the cent once, at the end.

**State cap.** The company's schedule of state returned-check charge limits:

| Contract state | The returned-payment fee is never more than |
|---|---|
| FL or LA | 40.00 |
| AL, MS or GA | 30.00 |
| any other state | no cap beyond these rules |

**The return charged.** The returned payment is the contract's latest return: the return with the latest return date, and among returns of the same date the one recorded first. Its return date and the channel of the original payment are those recorded on that return.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

1. A Texas contract, tier fee 25.00, nothing added or taken: 25.00; Texas has no cap here, so the fee is 25.00.
2. A Florida contract with an assembled amount of 46.30: capped at 40.00.
3. A Georgia contract with an assembled amount of 31.75: capped at 30.00.
4. Any contract whose amounts taken exceed the amount and additions, leaving minus 2.40: the fee is 0.00, and no fee is booked.
